'''Disney+''' is [[The Walt Disney Company]]'s video on-demand streaming service, launched on [[November 12]], [[2019]] together with [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian'']], a ''[[Star Wars]]'' series exclusive to Disney+. Aside from collecting previously screened and televised ''Star Wars'' movies and series as well as some documentaries, additional Disney+ original series include the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|final season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']], [[Star Wars: The Bad Batch|''The Bad Batch'']], [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] specials, [[Star Wars: Visions|''Visions'']], ''[[Tales]]'', and [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures|''Young Jedi Adventures'']] in animation; [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], [[Star Wars: Ahsoka|''Ahsoka'']], and ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' in live-action; the limited live-action series [[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett|''The Book of Boba Fett'']], [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']], and [[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew|''Skeleton Crew'']]; and assorted documentaries and special effects shorts such as ''[[Light & Magic]]'' and [[Star Wars Biomes|''Biomes'']], respectively.

==History==
===Announcement===
[[File:DisneyPlusAvatarDarthVader.png|thumb|left|250px|Disney+ allows the use of an image of a ''Star Wars'' character as their viewer profile (Darth Vader profile pictured).]]
Disney+ was first announced in late [[2017]],<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2017/digital/news/disney-netflix-end-acquires-bamtech-espn-ott-services-1202519917|text=Disney to End Netflix Deal, Sets Launch of ESPN and Disney-Branded Streaming Services|author=Spangler, Todd|date=2017-08-08|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20190120033242}}</ref> with a plan of producing original film and television material in addition to catalog content.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://insidethemagic.net/2017/10/disney-will-create-five-original-films-per-year-new-streaming-service-promises-thousands-hours-content|text=Disney will create five original films per year for new streaming service, promises "thousands of hours" of content|author=Celestino, Mike|date=2017-10-06|work=[https://insidethemagic.net Inside the Magic]|archivedate=20190120033512}}</ref> Disney CEO [[Bob Iger (chief executive officer)|Bob Iger]] revealed that "a few" ''[[Star Wars]]'' series were among the content that would be produced for the service.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/star-wars-tv-series-disney-developing-a-few-streaming-service-1082523|text='Star Wars' TV Series: Disney Developing "a Few" for Its Streaming Service|author=Goldberg, Lesley ; Couch, Aaron|date=2018-02-06|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter]]|archivedate=20190120033628}}</ref> Some of these are ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/star-wars-live-action-series-launch-disney-streaming-service-1056755|text='Star Wars' Live-Action TV Series to Launch on Disney Streaming Service|author=Jarvey, Natalie|date=2017-11-09|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter]]|archivedate=20190120033729}}</ref> a [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|revival season]] of [[Cartoon Network]]'s animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', as well as the previous seasons,<ref name="SW-Star Wars: The Clone Wars to Return with New Episodes">{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2018-the-clone-wars-to-return|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' to Return with New Episodes}}</ref> and ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', centered on [[Cassian Jeron Andor]].<ref name="Cassian Andor Live-Action Series">{{SW|url=news/cassian-andor-live-action-series-announced|text=Cassian Andor Live-Action Series Announced}}</ref>

In May 2019, Iger said that a third live-action show may premiere on the service sometime prior to the intended [[2023]] release of a then-announced ''Star Wars'' film,<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.slashfilm.com/third-live-action-star-wars-series|text=A Third Live-Action 'Star Wars' Series May Be Released Between Episode 9 and the Next Trilogy|author=Anderton, Ethan|date=2019-05-14|work=[[Wikipedia:/Film|''/Film'']]|archivedate=20200105162934}}</ref> which was later revealed to be ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' centered on [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="ObiSeries">{{SW|url=news/the-galaxy-far-far-away-just-got-a-little-bigger|text=The Galaxy Far, Far Away Just Got A Little Bigger…}}</ref> A year later, it was announced that a fourth animated show focusing on [[Clone Force 99]], named ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', will debut on the service sometime in 2021.<ref name="badbatch">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-series-announce|text=''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'', An All-New Animated Series, to Debut on Disney+ in 2021}}</ref> According to [[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']], all of the service's original content was set for a "broad family appeal."<ref name="originals">{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/disney-plus-originals-streaming-star-wars-high-school-musical-1203120854|text=From 'Star Wars' to 'High School Musical': The Originals Headed to Disney's Streaming Service|author=Littleton, Cynthia|date=2019-01-29|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20191011224125}}</ref>

===2019 launch===
All ''Star Wars'' films were added to Disney+ within the first year of the service, and the [[The Mandalorian Season One|first season]] of ''The Mandalorian'' premiered on the day Disney+ debuted.<ref name="D+ Debut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-disney-plus-november-12|text=Here's Everything ''Star Wars'' Coming to Disney+ in the US on November 12|nolive=1}}</ref> The first season of ''The Mandalorian'' concluded on [[December 27]], 2019.<ref name="DTCIs1">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20211208101433}}</ref>

===2020 releases===
[[File:Lucasfilm-future-2020.png|thumb|right|250px|Kathleen Kennedy announcing the new slate of ''Star Wars'' Disney+ products at a December 2020 Investor's Call]]
The seventh season of ''The Clone Wars'' animated series premiered on Disney+ on [[February 21]], [[2020]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-returns-on-disney-february-21|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Returns on Disney+ February 21}}</ref> It concluded on [[May 4]], [[2020]].<ref name="Finale May 4">{{SW|url=news/disney-gallery-the-mandalorian-announce|text=Go Behind the Scenes in the New Disney+ Series ''Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian''}}</ref> The [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of ''The Mandalorian'' premiered on Disney+ on [[October 30]], 2020<ref name="S2 Release Date">{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-season-two-october-30|text=''The Mandalorian'' Season Two Begins October 30 on Disney+}}</ref> The second season concluded on [[December 18]], 2020.<ref name="DTCIs2">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_s2_project_profile_10-13-20_dd7f9772.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Season Two Media Kit|date=2020-10-13|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International|Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]]|pages=[https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_s2_project_profile_10-13-20_dd7f9772.pdf#page=1 p. 1]|archivedate=20201105060737}}</ref>

On [[November 17]], 2020, the animated film ''[[The LEGO Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' aired on Disney+.<ref name="LEGO SW Holiday Special">{{SW|url=news/the-lego-star-wars-holiday-special-disney-plus-announce|text=The ''LEGO Star Wars Holiday Special'' to Premiere on Disney+}}</ref> In [[December]] of 2020, Disney announced that roughly ten more ''Star Wars'' series would be added to the service in the coming years.<ref name="Ten">{{Twitter|Disney|status/1337152322653351936|Disney|quote=Over the next few years, roughly 10 @Marvel series, 10 @StarWars series, 15 Disney live action, @DisneyAnimation, and @Pixar series, plus 15 all-new Disney live action, Disney Animation, and Pixar features will be released directly on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20201210223133}}</ref>

===2021 releases===
On [[April 2]], [[2021]], Disney+ began streaming ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]'', ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]'', the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series, [[Genndy Tartakovsky]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' animated series, and the animated ''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]'' segment from ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' under the ''[[Star Wars Vintage Collection]]'' banner.<ref name="D23 April 2021">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-april-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in April 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> [[StarWars.com]] also confirmed that the animated ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'' would join the ''Vintage Collection'' later in 2021,<ref name="SW-Vintage">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-vintage-collection-disney-plus|text=The ''Star Wars'' Vintage Collection Has Arrived on Disney+!}}</ref> appearing first in the UK and Ireland on [[June 18]].<ref name="Fantha">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/film-music-tv/droids-arrives-on-disney-plus-in-the-uk|text=Droids arrives on Disney Plus in the UK|work=[https://www.fanthatracks.com Fantha Tracks]|archivedate=20210618124901}}</ref>

The [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the animated series ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' first aired on Disney+ on [[May 4]], 2021.<ref name="D23 May 2021">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> The first season concluded on [[August 13]].<ref name="D23 August">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-august-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in August 2021}}</ref> On May 4, the television special ''[[Star Wars Biomes]]'' premiered on Disney+. It featured various locations from the Star Wars films as well as ''The Mandalorian''.<ref name="Biomes Announcement">{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2021/tv/news/the-simpsons-star-wars-disney-plus-the-force-awakens-from-its-nap-1234964880|text='The Simpsons' Meets 'Star Wars' in First Look at Disney Plus Short 'The Force Awakens From Its Nap'|archivedate=20210503145202|author=Earl, William|date=2021-05-03}}</ref>

The [[Star Wars: Visions Volume 1|first volume]] of the anime series ''[[Star Wars: Visions]]'' premiered on Disney+ on [[September 22]], 2021.<ref name="SW Visions Release">{{SW|url=news/anime-expo-lite-star-wars-visions|text=Anime Expo Lite: 20 Things We Learned from the ''Star Wars: Visions'' Panel}}</ref> On [[October 2]], 2021, the animated film ''[[LEGO Star Wars Terrifying Tales]]'' was released on Disney+.<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/lego-star-wars-terrifying-tales-announce|text=Prepare Yourself For Haunted Happenings in ''LEGO® Star Wars Terrifying Tales''}}</ref>

===2023 releases===
The [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' was released on [[January 4]], [[2023]].<ref name="D23">{{SW|url=news/d23-expo-2022-lucasfilm|text=D23 Expo 2022: All the ===2024 releases===
The [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third and final season]] of ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' began airing on [[February 21]], [[2024]] and concluded on May 1, 2024.<ref name="SW.com Trailer">{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]'', the second installment of the ''Tales'' series following ''Tales of the Jedi'',<ref name="Disneypress Tales of the Empire" /> was released on May 4, 2024.<ref name="TotE trailer">{{SWYouTube|8SIST9t72kY|Tales of the Empire | Official Trailer | Disney+}}</ref> 

''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' began airing on [[June 4]], 2024 and concluded on [[July 16]], 2024.<ref name="Acolyte">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The first part of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]'' was released on [[August 14]], 2024.<ref name="YJA Season 2">{{SW|url=news/young-jedi-adventures-season-2-and-nubs-shorts|text=''Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures'' Returns for Season 2}}</ref> The animated series ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy]]'' premiered on [[September 13]], 2024.<ref name="Rebuild">{{SW|url=news/lego-star-wars-rebuild-the-galaxy|text=Get Ready for Darth Jar Jar, TIE-Wings, and More in ''LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy''}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' premiered on [[December 2]] and concluded on [[January 14]], [[2025]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref>

===2025 releases===
The second half of [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|''Young Jedi Adventures'' Season Two]] was released on [[March 19]], 2025.<ref name="YJA Season 2 Resume">{{SW|url=news/young-jedi-adventures-season-2-and-nubs-shorts|text=''Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures'' Returns for Season 2}}</ref> The [[Light & Magic Season 2|second season]] of ''[[Light & Magic]]'', a documentary series focusing on the history of [[Industrial Light & Magic]], was released on [[April 18]].<ref name="L&M Season 2">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1900319346431582294|[[Star Wars]]|quote=See how @ILMVFX changed movie making. Light & Magic Season 2 is coming to @DisneyPlus April 18.|archivedate=20250313225333}}</ref>

The [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of ''Andor'' began airing on [[April 22]] and concluded on [[May 13]].<ref name="Andor S2">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1909667562528321799|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. Andor returns for its final season. Don't miss the three-episode premiere streaming April 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/vr3kt}}</ref> On [[May 4]], 2025, Disney+ released ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'', the third installment of the ''Tales'' anthology series,<ref name="Tales of the Underworld">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-underworld-announce|text=Two Favorite ''Star Wars'' Bounty Hunters are Back for ''Tales of the Underworld''}}</ref> as well as POV videos of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge (special)|''Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge'']] and [[Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (special)|''Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance'']] at [[Disneyland]], presented by Coca-Cola.<ref>[https://disneyparksblog.com/disney-experiences/guide-to-star-wars-on-may-the-4th-at-disney-parks-and-at-home/ May the 4th at Disney Parks and at Home - Disney Parks Blog]</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bo8qDExRY_I Disney+ | POV Journey Through Star Wars: Galaxy’s Edge and Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance]</ref>

''[[LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy - Pieces of the Past]]'', the sequel to ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy]]'', was released on [[September 19]].<ref name="Pieces of the Past">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-celebration-2025-lego-star-wars-rebuild-the-galaxy-pieces-of-the-past|text=''LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy: Pieces of the Past'' Will Feature LEGO BrickHeadz Ahsoka and… Jaxxon?!}}</ref>
The [[Star Wars: Visions Volume 3|third volume]] of [[Star Wars: Visions|''Star Wars Visions'']] was released on [[October 29]].<ref name="SW Visions Volume 3">{{SW|url=news/why-we-love-star-wars-visions|text=Why We Love the Unique Stories of ''Star Wars: Visions''}}</ref> The [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Three|third season]] of ''Young Jedi Adventures'' was released on [[December 8]].<ref name="YJA Season 3">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-celebration-2025-young-jedi-adventures-season-3|text=''Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures'' Season 3 Coming This Fall!}}</ref>
